description: This PHP file defines functions to convert a database recordset into an HTML table representation, with support for multiple tables, headers, and data formatting. It is part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer library.

methods.name: rs2html
methods.description: Converts a database recordset to an HTML table, with options for headers, formatting, and output mode.

methods.name: arr2html
methods.description: Converts a 2D array to an HTML table, optionally with headers.
